title: Grouped-query attention
brief: Implement GQA with an output gate and a mask that stays correct behind a cached prefix.
hints: Query row i of the current block sits at absolute position i + (kv_len - q_len).
Six query heads share each KV head, so repeat the KV heads along the head axis.
The q_proj emits queries and a gate side by side; split it, then apply sigmoid to the gate.
